desc: Compact, rugged, and ready: the PAUSA (Panzer Arms USA) BPA12 Bullpup Semi-Auto Shotgun delivers full-power 12-gauge performance in a short, maneuverable package. With an 18.5” barrel and a bullpup layout, it gives the reach of a full-length shotgun in an overall length as short as 28.3” (without muzzle brake), making it ideal for close-quarters, range sessions, or a compact field rig. Finished in OD Green and built to a balanced 9.5 lb (with magazine), it blends controllability and presence.
